Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for the run chase! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players of Bangladesh Women. Laura Wolvaardt will open the batting alongside Tazmin Brits for South Africa Women. Marufa Akter will get proceedings underway with the ball here.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, a target of 114 to decide who will go to the semi-final. Will it be South Africa Women or will New Zealand Women get a backdoor entry? It all depends on how Bangladesh Women bowl. It's going to be an excellent chase. Stay tuned...

Nonkululeko Mlaba (4-0-21-1) comes up for a quick chat. Says that she really enjoyed the crowd and it feels special to play at home. Adds that the key to her success is all about being consistent. Feels that 114 is not the biggest total and she is counting on her batters to chase it down. On the surface, Mlaba shares that it is a tricky surface but with quality strokes, runs can be scored here.

South Africa Women have done a fine job to restrict Bangladesh Women to a very much gettable total. All the bowlers were neat and tidy and the hosts would have taken a target of 114 on any day. But this is not just another day. There is the pressure of a knockout and we know the history of South Africa, as a nation, in such a situation. The word 'chokers' often comes to use and the way they were panicking in the field, gave a glimpse of the same.

A sedate batting show from Bangladesh Women. At the start, after losing two wickets, they concentrated on preserving the wickets and skipper Nigar Sultana formed a steady stand with Sobhana Mostary. Sultana was involved in yet another partnership, with Shorna Akter but their innings lacked the desired impetus. With not many boundaries coming, they decided to pick couples and pressurized the fielders. There were a few errors from the home team as they felt the heat once the score touched 100.
FOUR! A brilliant strike to end the innings here. Slower one on a length around middle, Nahida Akter shuffles to her leg and pulls this over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary to end the innings.
Fuller outside off, Lata Mondal drives this to mid off for a single.
Fierce bouncer, head bound, Nahida Akter splices her attempted flat-batted shot to cover-point. They cross.

Slower one around the pads, Nahida Akter flicks this wide of diving short fine leg for a couple of runs. A short run has been called here as Nahida had not dragged her bat inside the line while turning for the second run. Basic missed in haste.
On a length around off, Lata Mondal edges her drive to point for a single.
Full and on pads, Nahida lofts this over mid off for a single.
Full outside off, Nahida Akter pushes this to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Lata Mondal pushes this to mid off for a single.
Fuller around middle, Lata Mondal works this to deep mid-wicket and they are up and running for a couple.
Lata Mondal is the new batter.

OUT! Stumps rattled! Ayabonga Khaka nails yet another very full delivery, around leg and drifts in, Fargana Hoque jumps out of the crease to flick it on the leg side but misses. It clips her left boot and deflects behind to disturb the stumps.
Fuller outside off, Fargana Hoque pushes this to cover-point for a single. The fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end. They run an overthrow too. 100 up!
Fuller on pads, Fargana Hoque flicks this of her pads for a couple of runs towards square leg. Leg-byes signalled. Brilliant bit of running here.
Ayabonga Khaka is back on. 3-0-15-1 are her bowling figures so far.
Bouncer steaming past the head of Nahida Akter. She ducks away from this.
Yorker around middle, Nahida Akter guides this to mid-wicket for a single. The throw hits the bat of Fargana Hoque and they run off a deflection from that too. Ismail looks unpleased here.
Fuller delivery drifting down the leg, Fargana Hoque looks to flick but misses out. Wide signalled and they run a single too as the keeper fails to take the ball cleanly.
Short-pitched delivery outside off, Nahida Akter manages to get this past the bowler for a single.

Short in length on top of off, Fargana Hoque cuts this to Marizanne Kapp at point who takes a shy at the non-striker's end but misses as they take a single. The long-on fielder releases a direct hit at the bowler's end, a bit needless and Shabnim Ismail is not happy.
Slower delivery on a length around middle, Nahida Akter tucks this to short mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on middle, Fargana Hoque pushes this to long on for a single.
Shabnim Ismail (2-0-5-1) is back on to bowl at the death.
Back of a length around middle, Fargana Hoque tucks this to square leg for a single.

Comedy of errors as a single has been converted into three runs. Length ball on middle, Akter helps it to mid-wicket and they cross. Kapp tries to be funky with her footwork as she attempts to pick up the ball. Ends up deflecting it in the deep and they cross for another run. The fielder from the deep comes rushing in and fires a throw at the keeper who fails to collect. They cross for one more. Three runs in total.
Bouncer to welcome Nahida Akter, she ducks away from this.
Nahida Akter is in next.

OUT! Drags it on! It's a body blow to Bangladesh Women as their skipper departs at the backend of the innings. A slower one from Marizanne Kapp. It's loopy and full outside off, dipping in late, Sultana goes down to sweep but it takes the inner portion of her bat and cannons onto the stumps. Marizanne Kapp flashes a big smile.
Short-pitched delivery over middle, Fargana Hoque pulls this to mid-wicket for a single. With this rate, they aren't getting past 110 today.
Back of a length on middle, Nigar Sultana nudges this to square leg for a single
Marizanne Kapp is back on. 1 for 15 in her 3 overs so far.
On a length with no pace on offer, Nigar Sultana works this to mid-wicket and they run a single here.
Full outside off, Fargana Hoque walks down and milks this to long on for a single.
Fargana Hoque is the new batter.

OUT! Cleaned up! Fantastic delivery from Ayabonga Khaka. She gets a full ball to drift into the batter, Shorna Akter takes a step down, trying to work it around but yorks herself and misses the delivery. It sneaks through and rattles the stumps. The 25-run stand comes to a close, perhaps at the wrong time for Bangladesh Women.
On a length around middle, Nigar Sultana pushes this to short cover for a single.
Fuller around the pads, Shorna Akter nudges this to square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Nigar Sultana jabs this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and on off, Sultana sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Skidding down leg, worked behind square leg for one.
FOUR! Fine shot! Full and floated, around off, Shorna gives the charge and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Clean hit.
Flighted and around off, Akter tries to sweep but ends up bottom-edging it on the surface.
Too full and on off, Sultana sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Loopy and full, around middle, Nigar paddles it down to fine leg for two runs.
Nonkululeko Mlaba continues for her last over.
Reaches out to a full ball and guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Nigar walks forward and smashes it over covers for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, driven to mid on for one.
Full delivery outside off, pushed to covers for one.
On middle, helped to mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length, around off, Shorna tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. It drops safely near short third man.
Nadine de Klerk (1-0-7-0) replaces Chloe Tryon.
Short and around off, Akter goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it over square leg for a single.
Full and around off, knocked down to mid on for one.
Loopy and full, around off, Sultana drives it through cover-point for a single.
A gentle arm ball around off, Shorna pushes it off the inner half to long on. She gets off the mark with a run.
Sobhana Mostary departs after a good knock of 27. Shorna Akter walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED! Nonkululeko Mlaba returns for another over and strikes with her first delivery. Delivers an arm ball, full and around off, Sobhana Mostary goes down to heave it over the leg side but fails to connect. The ball skids on and disturbs the stumps. The set batter is dismissed and that ends a 32-run partnership.
FOUR! Superb shot! Flighted around off, very full in length, Nigar Sultana goes aerial and thumps it inside-out over extra cover.
Bowls it short again, Sobhana pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and close to off, Mostary goes back and cuts it to point.
Wide! Loopy and full, down the leg side, Sobhana tries to sweep but misses. 50 up!
Loopy around off, Sultana plays the reverse sweep to short third man for a single.
Dropped! Flighted and full, landing on middle, Mostary slogs it over mid-wicket and Tazmin Brits puts down a sitter in the deep. They cross for a single.
Short in length and close to off, Mostary goes on the back foot and taps it down to backward point.
Angling down the leg side, the batter fails to flick and it goes off her pads to square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Eases a full ball through backward point for a single.
Digs it in short, outside off, Mostary controls the bounce well and runs it down to third man for a run.
Short and around off, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks break. Slow going from Bangladesh Women but they have done well to not lose more than two wickets so far. They will look to up the scoring rate in the coming overs and Sobhana Mostary will have to take the lead. Skipper Nigar Sultana can bat deep and that should be the plan. For South Africa Women, it will be all about keeping a firm hand on the scoring rate and not allow any momentum to the batting team.
Flatter trajectory, on a length outside off, Nigar Sultana cuts it to third man for a couple.
Short in length outside off, Nigar Sultana cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Nigar Sultana cuts this towards point.
Tossed up around off, Nigar Sultana pushes this to mid off.
Tossed up outside off, Nigar Sultana pushes this to extra cover for no run.

Excellent fielding in the deep! Full and wide outside off, Sobhana Mostary drives this to deep extra cover for three runs. A good bit of fielding by Marizanne Kapp, who runs across to her right from deep cover, puts in a slide to pull it back in. Nadine de Klerk, who has come in from mid off, puts the brakes at the right time, slips a bit but then recovers and sends the ball back in play. Saves one run.
Chloe Tryon comes into the attack as well.
Full and wide outside off, Sobhana Mostary pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length around off, Sobhana Mostary taps this to point for nothing.
Full and outside off, Nigar Sultana slices this to third man for a single.
On a length around the pads, Sobhana Mostary drags her attempted pull shot down to fine leg for a single.
Short in length outside off, Sobhana Mostary looks to guide this to third man but misses out.

FOUR! Lucky for Sobhana Mostary as she edges this for a boundary. Full and wide outside off, Sobhana Mostary tries to drive but gets a bottom edge. The ball races away to third man where Nonkululeko Mlaba puts in a dive but in vain.
Nadine de Klerk is introduced into the attack.
Fuller around off, Sobhana Mostary pushes this to long on for a single.
Flighted around off, Nigar Sultana sweeps this towards square leg for a single.
Short in length around middle, Sobhana Mostary helps this to short fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Sobhana Mostary taps this to cover-point and looks for a run. Sent back.
Length dragged back a bit, Sobhana Mostary cuts this to point.
Tossed up outside off, Nigar Sultana pushes this to cover-point for a single.
Nonkululeko Mlaba returns to bowl her second over. None for 3 so far.
Touch fuller outside off, Sobhana Mostary cuts it to point.
On a length around off, Nigar Sultana taps this to cover-point and they run for it. Single taken.
Back of the hand, on a length shaping in, Nigar Sultana pushes this to short mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, Nigar Sultana fails to connect as the keeper collects this.
On a length, top of off, Nigar Sultana blocks it out.
Slower one, fuller outside off, Nigar Sultana looks to poke but misses out.
Powerplay is done and South Africa Women are off to a fine start. Ayabonga Khaka comes back into the attack.
On a length around off, Nigar Sultana taps it to short cover and they run for it.
Back-of-a-length delivery, going down her body, Nigar Sultana ducks and the keeper collects.
On a length outside off, Nigar Sultana pokes at this but gets beaten by the pace.
On a length outside off, Nigar Sultana keeps the bat close to her body and allows it through to the keeper.
Skipper Nigar Sultana walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shabnim Ismail roars in delight. Short in length and around off, Shamima Sultana camps back and tries to pull but the bounce gets big on her bat. It takes the top edge and flies towards mid-wicket where Tazmin Brits takes the skier safely. Earlier, Shamima was dropped off the bowling of Shabnim but she failed to make much use of that life.
Commentary.Howout: c Tazmin Brits b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller outside off, Shamima Sultana drives this to extra cover for nothing.
Shabnim Ismail is back on to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Uses the angle of the bowler and tucks a length ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Beaten! Serves it on a good length, outside off, Sultana pushes inside the line, without any footwork and gets beaten.
Around middle and leg, on a length, Mostary drops it with gentle hands to square leg and they cross again.
Slower one, on the pads, Shamima eases it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Fractionally short and around leg, Mostary glances it off her hips to fine leg for a single.
Full and on middle, it's worked behind square leg for a run.
FOUR! Finishes the over well. Full toss on middle, Mostary gets on top of the bounce and smashes it over backward square leg for a boundary. 9 from the over!
Pitches it up and outside off, Sobhana goes aerial and lofts it behind mid off for a brace.
Very full and wide outside off, Sobhana reaches out to drive and it goes off the toe end to mid off.
Back of a length, on off, Sobhana hangs back, uses the angle of the bowler and pulls it through the gap at mid-wicket for a couple.
Identical to the last delivery, Sobhana tries to play straight but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects back to the bowler.
Fuller and around off, drifting in, Shamima flicks it towards short fine leg for a single.
Ayabonga Khaka comes into the attack.
A terrific first over from Marizanne Kapp! Lands it on a length, around middle, Mostary tries to flick but misses. She is hit high on the front leg.
Angles in a length ball around off, Sobhana again stays back in defense.
On a length, around off, Sobhana defends it from the back foot.
Wide! Length ball down the leg side, left alone.
Who will bat next? It's Sobhana Mostary.

OUT! CAUGHT! Marizanne Kapp delivers it on a good length, around off, Murshida Khatun steps back to make room and attempts for a lofted shot over covers. She fails to connect well and Nadine de Klerk takes a wonderful catch over her head at mid off with a perfectly timed jump. Brilliantly done and Bangladesh Women lose an early wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Nadine de Klerk b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around off, a confident drive off the front foot by Khatun but she again picks the mid off fielder.
Fullish and on middle, shaping in, Murshida pushes it down to mid off.
Marizanne Kapp comes into the attack.
Pitches it up and around off, Sultana drives it straight to mid off.
FOUR! Fine shot! Back of a length, close to off, Shamima Sultana stays back and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Beaten! Speedy delivery, full and outside off, Sultana throws her hand at it and gets beaten.
Dropped! Short in length and wide outside off, Sultana cuts it aerially to backward point where the ball goes in and comes out of Laura Wolvaardt's hands. Early liShamima Sultana!
Lands it on a length and around off, curling away, Sultana pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Bowls a near-yorker, wide outside off, Sultana tries to dig it out but misses.
Who will bowl from the opposite end? Shabnim Ismail to run in...
Loopy and full, around leg, Khatun flicks off the inner half to short fine leg.
Play and a miss! Short delivery, around off and skidding away, Khatun hangs back to punch again but misses this time.
Flatter arm ball, around off, it's punched off the back foot to covers.
Drags her length short again, on middle, Sultana pulls it in front of square leg for a single.
Short again, wide outside off, Sultana cuts but finds the point fielder.
Bangladesh Women are away! Starts with a short ball, around off, Shamima pulls it over mid-wicket and they cross for a hesitant second run.

Time to get underway. The players are coming onto the field. Murshida Khatun and Shamima Sultana are the openers for Bangladesh Women.​ Nonkululeko Mlaba is getting ready to bowl the first over. Here we go...
Both teams are out for their respective National Anthems. It would be the National Anthem of Bangladesh Women's first and then South Africa Women's.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Murshida Khatun, Shamima Sultana (WK), Sobhana Mostary, Nigar Sultana (C), Shorna Akter, Fargana Hoque (replaces Ritu Moni), Lata Mondal (replaces Rumana Ahmed), Nahida Akter, Fahima Khatun, Jahanara Alam (replaces Salma Khatun), Marufa Akter

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Tazmin Brits, Laura Wolvaardt, Marizanne Kapp, Sune Luus (C) (100th T20I for her), Chloe Tryon, Nadine de Klerk, Anne Bosch (replaces Delmi Tucker), Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka (replaces Masabata Klaas), Nonkululeko Mlaba.
TOSS- Bangladesh Women have won the toss and they have decided to bat first.

The place in the semis is there for the taking for the hosts. Bangladesh Women will have to play out of their skin in order to get a positive result from this game. It's an outstanding game to end the group stages and let us see what unfolds as the evening progresses. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates...

Bangladesh Women, on the other hand, would want to end the campaign with a victory that they have thirsted for so badly to date. It has been a really poor campaign so far for them as they haven't put up a fight in any of the games, losing all by big margins. In the last game against the White Ferns, the Asian side lost by 71 runs. The bowlers have managed to pick just 8 wickets in total in three games played. The results have totally reflected in their performance which has been below par so far. Can they sign off on a high and spoil the South African Women's party?

It has been a topsy-turvy tournament for the hosts as they started the campaign with a defeat against Sri Lanka Women followed by a victory against the White Ferns. In their last game, they lost to Australia Women in a low-scoring encounter. The Proteas would be counting on the services of ace batter Laura Wolvaardt and all-round ability of Marizanne Kapp heavily.

We couldn't have predicted a better ending to the group stages with all at stake in the last game. South Africa Women, with a victory, could climb all the way up to the second spot, dethroning New Zealand Women, as they have a superior NRR. It's a virtual knockout for them as a win here would seal a spot for them in the semis.

Hello and welcome to all! South Africa Women will be battling against Bangladesh Women in the last game of the group stage of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. The match will be played at Newlands, Cape Town and there is plenty on the line for the African team.
... MATCH DAY ...

Things are shaping up nicely in Group A of the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup 2023. While Australia Women have already qualified for the semi-final from this group, New Zealand Women and South Africa Women are vying for the second semi-final spot and if the Proteas Women get over the line here, they will seal that spot for them. South Africa Women’s batting hasn’t exactly clicked in this T20 World Cup. Captain, Sune Luus has been their most consistent batter, collecting 70 runs in three matches. Opener Tazmin Brits played a vital knock of 45 off 36 balls against Australia Women. That performance will give the team a lot of confidence, particularly since the batting unit is woefully short of runs. Marizanne Kapp has led South Africa Women's bowling charts this tournament, taking 5 wickets in 3 innings, but she will hope to get some runs under her belt too. Slow left-arm spinner Nonkululeko Mlaba has taken four wickets, and these two bowlers will play a crucial role in keeping the Bangladesh Women batters in check. This is a huge game for them, and with the home crowd behind them, they would have that extra boost. Bangladesh Women, on the other hand, have had a forgettable tournament so far, losing all three matches they have played. This World Cup is already over for them, and they will be playing for pride. However, getting past a strong South African outfit on their home ground will be a herculean task. Skipper Nigar Sultana has led from the front, scoring 91 runs in three matches, but unfortunately, she has barely gotten any support from the other batters. 18-year-old right-arm seamer Marufa Akter has been the standout bowler for them, while others have consistently leaked runs except leggie Rumana Ahmed. They will want to end their tournament on a high with a victory. Let's see who comes out on top.
